Elena —

Thanks for the availability. Quick note: the US switches to DST on 14 March, and some of our EMEA stakeholders' calendars still show CET without the DST offset — I want to avoid a tangent where we book a slot that shifts for folks in the US.

Quick questions so we pick the right wall-clock time for everyone:
- The Madrid team listed CET — are those times fixed to Europe/Spain (UTC+1) or do you want to use local Madrid time that will move on 29 Mar?
- Is anyone joining from your APAC location (we should avoid early morning PST for west-coast attendees)

If Madrid intends 15:00 CET on Thu 18 Mar, that is 10:00 EDT (US east) on Thu 18 — which is fine for our east-coast engineers but will be 07:00 PDT for our west-coast SE. To be respectful of travel and timezones we can:
1) Keep Thu 18 Mar 15:00 CET (we'll ask west-coast to join from home)
2) Move to Fri 19 Mar 09:00 CET (04:00 EDT / 01:00 PDT — worse for US)
3) Propose an alternate window in the afternoon CET that is late morning EDT (e.g., 12:30 CET / 07:30 EDT)

Marissa and Grace, can you confirm whether a 10:00 EDT (15:00 CET) demo is workable from an engineering coverage perspective? If not, we'll propose an alternate.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
